title: World Model Entity
description: A node in the world model topology graph. Carries per-entity state read by both Argus and Phoenix.

entity_type.description: Entity class. Constrains which edge types are valid.

namespace.description: k8s namespace, sim namespace, or 'cluster' for nodes.

slo_target.description: Target availability expressed as a fraction (0.999 = 99.9%).

error_budget_remaining_minutes.description: Remaining error budget in minutes for the current SLO window.

fragility_score.description: 0 = perfectly robust, 1 = highly fragile. Computed by Phoenix from blast-radius and recent fault history.

security_posture.description: Current security posture assigned by Argus.

deleted_at.description: Tombstone timestamp. Entities are soft-deleted, never hard-deleted.

edge_type.description: depends-on: service→service/pod. runs-on: pod→node. routes-through: service→vlan/service.

weight.description: Dependency strength (0 = loosely coupled, 1 = hard dependency).

allowed_edges.description: Valid source→target entity type combinations per edge type.
